seriesTitle: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine

episodes.title: La colección
episodes.summary: When Berlin and Damián go fishing for a new multi-millionaire target, they end up on a mission in Seville that brings the whole gang back together.

episodes.title: Un canto a la vida
episodes.summary: High off the night's exploits with Candela, Berlin and the gang embark on a high-risk reconnaissance mission of the duke's sprawling country estate.

episodes.title: El síndrome de Stendhal
episodes.summary: While Roi and Cameron reluctantly stay behind, the events of the day take Berlin and the others back to the countryside with a brand new set of plans.

episodes.title: Naranjas de la China
episodes.summary: As the heist takes a new direction, Keila sets a daring strategy in motion. At a clandestine party, the duchess approaches Berlin and enrages Candela.

episodes.title: Demolition Boys
episodes.summary: As Damián hunts down lost luggage, Berlin mixes business with pleasure. At the duke's mansion, Keila and Bruce continue the team's search for the vault.

episodes.title: Pomelo Loves Mandarina
episodes.summary: The duke's scrutiny pushes Berlin to devise a decoy heist plan. At a candlelit dinner, Bruce opens up and the duchess communicates covertly with Damián.

episodes.title: La noche de las dos cobras
episodes.summary: Armed with new information, Damián attempts to solve the burning issue of the fireball. As Berlin falls deeper for Candela, his past catches up with him.

episodes.title: La felicidad es del que ama
episodes.summary: A night out in Peñíscola inspires Berlin to radically change his plans. Will he and the gang manage to pull off the greatest heist in history?
